7 Brew Teas & Chai: All 6 Teas, 4 Chais, Caffeine by Temperature

7 Brew publishes 33 teas, chais and matcha drinks. A medium runs about $4.65, and the numbers below — calories, caffeine, sugar and allergens — come straight from the official nutrition guide.

Medium is 24 oz iced or 16 oz hot depending on the drink. Where the guide lists more than one value for a size, the range is shown.

Tea caffeine depends on the temperature. Here is the whole map

Most pages give one caffeine number per tea. For two of the six bases that number is off by more than ten times if you order the other temperature. A medium Black Tea is 128 mg iced and 11 mg hot. A medium Paris Tea is 102 mg iced and 9 mg hot. The other four barely move: Green Tea is 60 iced and 50 hot (and its hot large, 99 mg, is the one case where hot beats iced), Earl Grey and Cinnamon Spice sit at 11 mg either way, and Decaf is 1 mg everywhere. All six plain bases are 0 calories and unsweetened until you say otherwise. Sweetness is a choice here, in quarter steps up to extra sweet. The full size-by-size table for every drink category is on the sizes and caffeine page.

Chai is not caffeine-free, and it is not zero. It is 16 to 19 mg

A claim went around that 7 Brew publishes no caffeine figure for chai, so any number must be a guess. This site printed a version of it on its own chai pages. It is wrong, and the chai pages here were corrected on October 28, 2026. The guide lists chai caffeine like everything else. A medium iced Chai Latte is 19 mg. The Brewchata is 16, and the Salted Honey and Sugar Cookie are 17 each. Hot runs slightly higher, and the frozen chiller is the strongest form, 29 mg in a medium plain chai. Low, yes. Roughly a sixth of a medium espresso drink. Zero, no. Google's AI answer on this query, a vague "17 to 50 mg," matches no size or preparation in the guide.

Two orders worth knowing by name

London Fog. Order a hot Earl Grey with vanilla and a steamed milk splash. The official menu sells the same build as the Vanilla Earl Grey card and never calls it a London Fog. Do not confuse it with Cloud 9, which is Earl Grey with lavender and vanilla. At 11 mg in a medium, it is the gentlest warm drink on this page.

Arnold Palmer. Half tea, half lemonade, a custom order, not a board drink. The base decides the caffeine: on iced Black Tea a medium lands around 106 to 128 mg before the lemonade half dilutes it, on Green Tea around 50 to 60. The May 2026 Fruit Roll-Up Green Tea Lemonade was the featured version of exactly this build. The lemonade side lives on the lemonades page.

Prices

Teas, chais and matcha lattes are priced as one group: about $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are researched estimates and vary by stand.

The brewed teas — black, green, Earl Grey, Paris, cinnamon spice and decaf — can be ordered plain or built with flavour syrups. The chai and matcha drinks are milk-based, so they carry more calories.

Teas, chai and matcha FAQ

Which 7 Brew tea has the most caffeine?

Black Tea, at about 128 mg in a medium.

Does 7 Brew have caffeine-free tea?

Yes — the decaf tea is the caffeine-free brewed option, and the fruit-based lemonades and fizz sodas contain no caffeine either.

Can 7 Brew teas be made sugar-free?

Yes. Teas and chais can be built with sugar-free syrups, and the guide publishes sugar-free versions of most flavoured teas. See the customization guide.

What is the best tea at 7 Brew?

By fan consensus, the Georgia Peach Green Tea (peach and strawberry over the green tea base) and the Paris Tea get named most. If you want caffeine, iced Black Tea is the strongest tea on the menu at 128 mg in a medium. If you want the opposite, Decaf is 1 mg at any size and the only base that is honest about being a bedtime drink.

Can you get sweet tea at 7 Brew?

Yes, but it is made to order, not pre-sweetened. The plain teas pour unsweetened at 0 calories, and you pick a sweetness level: quarter, half, regular or extra sweet. Southern-style sweet tea drinkers usually land on regular or extra. The named flavored teas (Georgia Peach, Cherry Blossom, Hula) arrive sweetened by their syrups.

Does 7 Brew chai have caffeine?

Yes: 19 mg in a medium iced Chai Latte, 16 in a Brewchata, 17 in a Salted Honey or Sugar Cookie. Hot runs a little higher and the frozen chiller is the strongest form at 29 mg in a medium plain chai. Claims that 7 Brew publishes no chai caffeine figure, or that chai is 0 mg, are both wrong. The guide lists it like every other drink.

How do I order a London Fog at 7 Brew?

Ask for a hot Earl Grey with vanilla and a steamed milk splash. The official menu carries the build as its Vanilla Earl Grey card; it just never uses the London Fog name. A medium has 11 mg of caffeine. The lavender version, Cloud 9 Earl Grey, is a separate drink.

Does 7 Brew sell tea bags?

No. The teas are stand drinks, brewed for the cup, and there is no retail bag of 7 Brew tea to buy. Fans identify the Paris blend as a well-known branded tea that is sold in bags elsewhere, but that identification is the fans', not a 7 Brew product claim.

Can I get an Arnold Palmer at 7 Brew?

Yes, as a custom order: half iced tea, half lemonade. Pick the base by caffeine. Black Tea is the strong version, Green Tea the middle, Decaf the 1 mg version. In May 2026 the stand featured a ready-made relative, the Fruit Roll-Up Green Tea Lemonade.
